title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: Final Preparation for Matan Torah (class #43)

chapters.title: Introduction to Shabuot and Preparation
chapters.about: Preparing for Shabuot and reliving Har Sinai

chapters.title: Choosing Avraham and Moshe
chapters.about: Why Hashem chose the Jewish nation as role models

chapters.title: Living Above Nature
chapters.about: The contrast between living in nature and living by the Torah

chapters.title: Lessons from Megillat Ruth
chapters.about: Elimelech's mindset versus the giving nature of Bet Lehem

chapters.title: The Cookie Analogy and Happiness
chapters.about: Being satisfied with what Hashem gives us

chapters.title: Adding Goodness Through Our Descriptions
chapters.about: Creating joy and bringing kedusha into the world

chapters.title: The Hating of Negative Speech and Judgement
chapters.about: Stopping destructive speech and learning to love

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses preparing for Shabuot and receiving the Torah by learning to live above nature and finding happiness in the present moment. She explains how to connect with ancestral wisdom and overcome triggers by looking back at the values passed down through generations.
questions: How can we live above nature in our daily lives?
Why did the Jewish people accept the Torah without asking what was written inside?
How should we handle situations when we feel triggered or upset by our children?
What is the connection between finding happiness in the present and receiving the Torah?
